audit.method: repo recon + static review + live dynamic testing + independent verification
confidence_limits: Full pytest suite not run end-to-end: local venv missing dnspython; in-container whole-suite SIGKILLed. 43 tests passed across first 6 files individually.
Detection precision/recall not computed: corpus unlabeled, small, biased.
FS-SEC-005 code-confirmed, not dynamically exploited (needs controlled DNS).
FS-SEC-006 Probable: delivery blocked by FS-DET-001; sanitizer stripped all vectors on real sample.

findings.title: Unauthenticated OS command injection -> container-root RCE
findings.root_cause: subprocess.run(..., shell=True) with f-string-interpolated untrusted target; sanitization only strips [<>\s!]; appuser has passwordless sudo nmap enabling root via --script NSE os.execute.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated RCE as container root via single file upload; pivot across docker networks.
findings.evidence: Crafted .domain upload wrote /tmp marker as appuser; sudo -n nmap --script wrote root-owned marker (uid=0).
findings.recommended_fix: Remove shell=True; argv lists only; strict host/IP allowlist regex ^[A-Za-z0-9.:_-]+$; remove nmap sudoers rule; prefer existing python fallbacks.
findings.regression_test: Upload .domain with ; $() ` and newline in target; assert no side-effect file and indicator rejected/literal; unit-assert no shell=True.

findings.title: Forgeable admin JWT (hardcoded shipped secret) + default credentials
findings.root_cause: HS256 key is a constant in source and shipped in .env; admin password default 'admin' compared in plaintext.
findings.impact: Complete admin takeover; can disable SSRF/external controls, manage rules/keys, read logs.
findings.evidence: Offline-forged token accepted by GET /api/settings/verify and GET /api/settings; admin/admin login succeeds.
findings.recommended_fix: Fail startup if secret/password unset or equals placeholder; random per-deploy secret; hash password; empty placeholders in .env.example.
findings.regression_test: Startup aborts on placeholder secret; token signed with old default rejected.

findings.title: Missing authorization on all job endpoints and job listing
findings.root_cause: No auth dependency on jobs router or GET /api/files; no owner binding on jobs.
findings.impact: Any client enumerates job IDs and reads/downloads all analyses and originals; can trigger recon/deobfuscation/delete.
findings.evidence: GET /api/files -> 15 jobs with filenames; GET /api/jobs/<id>/analysis -> 200 unauthenticated.
findings.recommended_fix: Auth dependency on jobs router + GET /api/files; owner-scoped reads; remove unauthenticated global listing.
findings.regression_test: Routes return 401 without token; user A cannot read user B's job.

findings.title: Reflective CORS with credentials
findings.root_cause: allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True reflects arbitrary Origin.
findings.impact: Any site makes credentialed cross-origin calls; combined with FS-SEC-003 enables drive-by data theft/recon.
findings.evidence: OPTIONS with Origin https://evil.example -> ACAO reflected + ACAC true.
findings.recommended_fix: Explicit origin allowlist; no wildcard+credentials; allow_credentials=False if header-token auth.
findings.regression_test: Non-allowlisted origin preflight has no ACAO header.

findings.title: SSRF: TOCTOU/DNS-rebinding and unvalidated per-analyzer connections
findings.root_cause: Validation resolves DNS then connection re-resolves independently (TOCTOU/rebinding); many analyzers connect to user host with no SSRF check.
findings.impact: Access to internal services / cloud metadata; internal port scanning via domain-intel path.
findings.evidence: Direct localhost/metadata/file:// blocked at fetch-url (verified). SSRF checks absent from tls_inspector, domain_analyzer, advanced_dns, passive_dns, threat_intelligence (grep tally).
findings.recommended_fix: Central pinned-IP egress client: resolve once, verify, connect to that IP with preserved host/SNI, re-check on redirect; route all network calls through it.
findings.regression_test: Resolver mock public-then-private -> connect blocked; assert modules use pinned client.

findings.title: Potential stored XSS in email HTML preview (denylist sanitizer, no DOMPurify)
findings.root_cause: Analyst preview renders backend-sanitized email HTML via dangerouslySetInnerHTML; sanitizer is BeautifulSoup html.parser denylist (decompose + delete on* + neutralize schemes), mXSS-prone; no allowlist/DOMPurify.
findings.impact: If a vector survives, script executes in authenticated analyst browser when viewing a malicious email.
findings.evidence: Real sample fully stripped; payload delivery blocked by FS-DET-001 so email path untested with payloads.
findings.recommended_fix: Allowlist sanitizer (nh3/bleach server-side + DOMPurify client-side) or sandboxed iframe srcdoc preview.
findings.regression_test: mXSS/polyglot battery through _clean_and_inspect_html -> no executable markup survives.

findings.title: .eml/.msg misclassified as HTML/SVG -> email forensics bypass
findings.root_cause: inspect_text_type runs before inspect_email_type and substring-matches <html>/<svg> in first 512 bytes, overriding the .eml container.
findings.impact: Trivial evasion: malicious email with leading markup skips all email forensics.
findings.evidence: Multipart .eml -> category html; inline <svg> -> category svg; real sample (HTML >512B in) -> category email.
findings.recommended_fix: Run email/container detection before markup sniffing; anchor markup detection at document start; honor known extensions.
findings.regression_test: .eml/.msg with leading <html>/<svg> classify as email (multipart and single-part fixtures).

findings.title: Hybrid Analysis tags mislabeled as MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs
findings.root_cause: mitre_attck built from 'mitre_attcks' or raw 'tags' via str(m) with no ATT&CK-ID validation.
findings.recommended_fix: Only map entries matching T\d{4}(\.\d{3})?; keep other tags separate.
findings.regression_test: Non-ATT&CK tags excluded from ATT&CK field.

findings.title: Test suite not runnable end-to-end (collection crash / OOM-style kill)
findings.root_cause: Missing test deps (dnspython) locally; whole-suite SIGKILL in container from heavy parallel imports and live network/subprocess calls in unit tests.
findings.impact: No reliable CI signal; regressions uncaught.
findings.evidence: Local collection ModuleNotFoundError 'dns' x17; container whole-suite exit 137; 43 tests passed across first 6 files individually.
findings.recommended_fix: Pin test deps; mark/mock network+subprocess tests; bounded parallelism; timeouts; documented make test.
findings.regression_test: Full suite green in CI within memory/time budget.

findings.title: API docs/OpenAPI exposed in production
findings.root_cause: FastAPI docs_url/openapi_url enabled regardless of APP_ENV.
findings.recommended_fix: Disable docs/openapi in production or gate behind admin auth.

findings.title: Verbose error echoes exception text to clients
findings.root_cause: HTTPException detail includes raw exception str.
findings.recommended_fix: Log server-side; return generic client message.
